reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and consistent with that, no redline text was altered and no comment was proposed — appropriate for a retained internal evidence finding.

The cited text supports the conclusion: Section 3.19 with the 'Exclusive Period' definition (1.1.68) restricts SFJ (counterparty) and its Affiliates from clinical trials/sales of Competing Products, which benefits our party (PB) and per the detection guidance is expressly not a deviation.

Sections 2.4.1–2.4.2 affirmatively permit each Party, including PB, to delegate to Affiliates and contract with listed or JDC-approved CROs and Vendors, showing no requirements-contract or 'sole supplier' obligation on the Customer; the deterministic check ('no requirements/sole-supplier obligation on Customer remains') is satisfied.

Rationale correctly distinguishes Article 7's negative covenants over IP/royalty streams (including the 7.5.5 Licensing Transaction consent gate with its Excluded Licensing Transaction carve-out) as financing covenants outside the scope of this exclusive-dealing rule, so the preferred position (no exclusivity burden on Customer) is met.
